summary: Checks each intent a person, a palette, a tour or a script sends against the target's capability in the same cycle, then turns it into a commit, a session entry or a request.
creates: a keyed family of capability nodes, one per target and action kind shown, collected when no panel shows them

faults.when: The intent's capability is off; the refusal carries its plain reason.
The target changed in another window since the intent was made.
An input outside the action's declared limits.

lifetime: Per window, while the window runs.

x-friction.gap: Capabilities are a large sparse family (about 200 kinds by every target shown), some costing 30 ms, re-read on every paint; today the heavy panels are throttled by hand.
x-friction.closes: Nodes made per key on first demand and collected when undemanded, with recomputation throttled and never during a gesture.
